ptv-p01-v01.quick_english: Unsurpassable how O Lord, by self Kaula-accomplishment-giving, by which by mere recognition to Khecarī-evenness may go.

ptv-p01-v02.quick_english: This secret great secret tell to me O Lord; heart-abiding but which power, Kaulinī clan-mistress.

ptv-p01-v03.quick_english: Her to me tell O Lord of gods, by which to fullness I go — hear O Goddess O great fortuned, of answer even unsurpassable.

ptv-p01-v04.quick_english: I tell, no doubt, at once Kaula-accomplishment-giving; Kaula this rite O Goddess, of me in heart-sky standing.

ptv-p01-v05.quick_english: Now first moon-days all, vowels ending in drop; inside that by time-yoking, moon-sun proclaimed.

ptv-p01-v06.quick_english: Earth-beginning realities, ending with person, in five in order, in ka-etc classes, in ma-sound-ending, O fair vowed.

ptv-p01-v07.quick_english: Of wind-fire-water-lords, of supports fourfold; above that famed beginning with śa, before, brahma-five.

ptv-p01-v08.quick_english: Rootless, that-ordered, to be known, ending in kṣa, emanation declared; of all and indeed of mantras, of wisdoms and, O famed lady.

ptv-p01-v09.quick_english: This womb told fully in all tantras always; joined with fourteen O lucky lady, joined with tithi-lord-end; third brahma O fair hipped, heart of Bhairava-self.

ptv-p02-v10.quick_english: This not yoginī-born, not Rudra gets plainly — heart of god of gods, at once yoga-release-giving.

ptv-p02-v11.quick_english: On its utterance made rightly, mantra-seal host great — at once goes to face-to-faceness, marked by own-body-possession.

ptv-p02-v12.quick_english: A moment remembers who but in kiss, navel-sealed — he binds then body, mantra-seal-host, man.

ptv-p02-v13.quick_english: Past-future-things asked he tells even; within a watch what meant, god-form uttering.

ptv-p02-v14.quick_english: Face to face sees undoubted, drawn by Rudra-powers; by mere two watches, sky-standing becomes remembering.

ptv-p02-v15.quick_english: By three mothers all, yogeśvarīs mighty; heroes, hero-lords, perfected, strong śākinī-host.

ptv-p02-v16.quick_english: Having come, pledge having given, by Bhairava urged — they give supreme accomplishment, fruit which or desired.

ptv-p02-v17.quick_english: By this accomplished ones will accomplish, and effect mantra-men.

ptv-p02-v18.quick_english: Whatever in Bhairava tantra, all from this succeeds; from power of mantra-potency-possession, not by controller.

ptv-p03-v19.quick_english: Unseen circle even thus who anyone knows truly — he sharing accomplishment may be ever, he yogin, he and initiated.

ptv-p03-v20.quick_english: By this by mere known, is known by all powers; common to śākinī-clan may be, yoga even without for.

ptv-p03-v21.quick_english: Unknowing rite, knowing ordinance becomes toward worship; time-fire from beginning having made, ending in māyā, gone in brahma-body.

ptv-p03-v22.quick_english: Śiva whose end is boundless all, supreme power-triad deemed; inside that being whatever, on pure path standing.

ptv-p03-v23.quick_english: Atom pure before long lordly knowing reaches; its impeller Śiva to be known, all-knowing supreme lord.

ptv-p03-v24.quick_english: All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright; as in banyan seed standing, power-formed great tree.

ptv-p03-v25.quick_english: So standing in heart-seed world this moving-unmoving; thus who knows in truth, of him going-to-freedom.

ptv-p03-v26.quick_english: Initiation becomes undoubted, free from sesame-ghee-offering; on crown, on face and, on heart, on hidden, on form so indeed and.

ptv-p03-v27.quick_english: Placing having done, topknot having bound, enchanted with twenty-seven; with each one of directions binding, of ten even should have made.

ptv-p04-v28.quick_english: Three claps before having given with sound for obstacle-quelling; by topknot-number muttered, with water should sprinkle then.

ptv-p04-v29.quick_english: Flower etc in order all, mark or altar and or; by fourteen muttered, with flower seat-making.

ptv-p04-v30.quick_english: There emanation should worship hero, again very seat then; emanation but having put in casket, after worship should begin.

ptv-p04-v31.quick_english: Full of all realities, graced with all limbs — should worship goddess great-fortuned, enchanted with twenty-seven.

ptv-p04-v32.quick_english: Then with fragrant flowers and according to power should honor; should worship with supreme devotion, and own self should offer.

ptv-p04-v33.quick_english: Thus worship told; in fire-rite even this rule: whose worship-rule done, rightly remembering seed succeeds.

ptv-p04-v34.quick_english: Without beginning end, seed blossoming, gone mid-tithis; gone inside heart-lotus should meditate, moon-ray ever should practise.

ptv-p04-v35.quick_english: Which which desires desires, them them quickly may get; unknowing one to direct sight goes, all-knowingness no doubt.

ptv-p04-v36.quick_english: Thus mantra-fruit-getting, thus this Rudra-pair-text; this from practice: accomplishment, all-knowingness is got.

ptv-p01-v01.inference: The question seeks the how of the unsurpassable that grants Kaula accomplishment by autonomy, known by mere recognition.

option_choices.reason: Our bytes read svataḥ; Laghuvṛtti glosses svatantrataḥ (by absolute autonomy). Singh's sadyah is a rival manuscript reading — recorded, not adopted.

premises: By which mere recognition: to Khecarī-evenness (the engine and goal).
ptv-p01-v01.question: What is asked?
ptv-p01-v01.speaker: Devī (asking)

ptv-p01-v02.inference: The secret asked is the heart-abiding Kaulinī, mistress of the clan.
premises: This secret, great secret — tell me (the doubled secrecy).
ptv-p01-v02.question: What secret?
ptv-p01-v02.speaker: Devī (asking)

ptv-p01-v03.inference: Devī asks fullness; Bhairava answers: hear — even of the answer, the unsurpassable.
premises: Her tell me, Lord of gods, for my fullness (her half).
Even of the answer: the unsurpassable (answer beyond answers).
ptv-p01-v03.question: Who answers?
ptv-p01-v03.speaker: Devī and Bhairava (turning)

ptv-p01-v04.inference: No doubt, at once: the Kaula rite stands in my heart-sky — I tell it.
premises: I tell, no doubt, at once granting (swiftness promised).
Kaula this rite, O Goddess (the rite named).
ptv-p01-v04.question: What is promised?
ptv-p01-v04.speaker: Bhairava (promising)

ptv-p01-v05.inference: First: vowels ending in drop, moon-sun proclaimed inside by time's yoking.
premises: Now first: all moon-days, vowels ending in drop (the alphabet opened).
ptv-p01-v05.question: What is first?
ptv-p01-v05.speaker: Bhairava (enumerating)

ptv-p01-v06.inference: Realities earth-to-person in five, in ka-classes ending in ma.
ptv-p01-v06.question: What realities?
ptv-p01-v06.speaker: Bhairava (enumerating)

ptv-p01-v07.inference: Fourfold supports of wind-fire-water lords; above, śa-famed brahma-five.
premises: Above that, famed beginning with śa.
ptv-p01-v07.question: What supports?
ptv-p01-v07.speaker: Bhairava (enumerating)

ptv-p01-v08.inference: Rootless, that-ordered, kṣa-ending emanation declared — of all mantras and wisdoms.
premises: Of all mantras and wisdoms (the scope).
ptv-p01-v08.question: What emanation?
ptv-p01-v08.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)

ptv-p01-v09.inference: This womb told in all tantras always — fourteen-joined, tithi-lord-ended; third brahma, Bhairava-self's heart.
premises: This womb, told fully, everywhere always.
ptv-p01-v09.question: What womb?
ptv-p01-v09.speaker: Bhairava (revealing)

ptv-p02-v10.inference: Neither yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly gets this heart — at once yoga-release-giving.
premises: Not yoginī-born, not Rudra gets (the double exclusion).
Heart of god of gods, yoga-release-giving (the prize).
ptv-p02-v10.question: Who gets the heart?
ptv-p02-v10.speaker: Bhairava (withholding)

ptv-p02-v11.inference: Rightly uttered, the great host goes face to face at once, body-possession-marked.
premises: On its utterance made rightly (the condition).
At once to face-to-faceness, body-marked (the fruit).
ptv-p02-v11.question: What on right utterance?
ptv-p02-v11.speaker: Bhairava (promising)

ptv-p02-v12.inference: Remembering a moment in kiss, navel-sealed, he binds body and host.
premises: A moment remembers, in kiss (the act).
He binds body and mantra-host (the binding).
ptv-p02-v12.question: Who binds?
ptv-p02-v12.speaker: Bhairava (describing)

ptv-p02-v13.inference: Asked, he tells past and future; within a watch, the meant god-form uttered.
premises: Past-future things asked, he tells (the knowledge).
ptv-p02-v13.question: What does he tell?
ptv-p02-v13.speaker: Bhairava (describing)

ptv-p02-v14.inference: Face to face he sees the undoubted, Rudra-drawn; in two watches, sky-standing, remembering.
premises: Sees undoubted, drawn by Rudra-powers (the vision).
ptv-p02-v14.question: What does he see?
ptv-p02-v14.speaker: Bhairava (describing)

ptv-p02-v15.inference: By three: mothers, yogeśvarīs, heroes, perfected, śākinī-host gather.
premises: Mothers, yogeśvarīs, heroes, hero-lords, perfected (the host).
ptv-p02-v15.question: Who gathers?
ptv-p02-v15.speaker: Bhairava (summoning)

ptv-p02-v16.inference: Come, pledged, Bhairava-urged — they give supreme accomplishment, whatever fruit wished.
premises: Having come, pledge given, urged (the arrival).
ptv-p02-v16.question: What do they give?
ptv-p02-v16.speaker: Bhairava (granting)

ptv-p02-v17.inference: By this the accomplished will accomplish; mantra-men are effected.
ptv-p02-v17.question: What by this?
ptv-p02-v17.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)

ptv-p02-v18.inference: All in Bhairava-tantra succeeds from this — by mantra-power, no controller.
premises: Whatever in Bhairava-tantra, all succeeds from this.
ptv-p02-v18.question: What succeeds?
ptv-p02-v18.speaker: Bhairava (declaring)

ptv-p03-v19.inference: Who knows the unseen circle truly shares accomplishment — yogin and initiated, ever.
premises: Unseen circle even, known truly (the knowing).
ptv-p03-v19.question: Who shares accomplishment?
ptv-p03-v19.speaker: Bhairava (including)

ptv-p03-v20.inference: By mere this known by all powers — śākinī-clan-common even without yoga.
premises: By mere known, known by all powers (the recognition engine returns).
ptv-p03-v20.question: What without yoga?
ptv-p03-v20.speaker: Bhairava (freeing)

ptv-p03-v21.inference: Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing becomes toward worship — time-fire through māyā to brahma-body.
premises: Time-fire from beginning, māyā-ending, brahma-bodied (the passage).
ptv-p03-v21.question: Who becomes toward worship?
ptv-p03-v21.speaker: Bhairava (turning)

ptv-p03-v22.inference: Boundless-ended Śiva, supreme power-triad deemed; whatever stands on the pure path inside that.
premises: Śiva boundless-ended, triad deemed supreme (the deeming).
ptv-p03-v22.question: What stands inside?
ptv-p03-v22.speaker: Bhairava (deeming)

ptv-p03-v23.inference: The atom soon reaches pure lordly knowing; its impeller Śiva, all-knowing lord, to be known.
premises: Atom reaches pure lordly knowing before long (the ascent).
Its impeller Śiva to be known (the turn).
ptv-p03-v23.question: What does the atom reach?
ptv-p03-v23.speaker: Bhairava (raising)

ptv-p03-v24.inference: All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — as banyan-seed tree, power-formed.
premises: As in banyan seed standing (the simile).
ptv-p03-v24.question: What is the tree?
ptv-p03-v24.speaker: Bhairava (imaging)

ptv-p03-v25.inference: So the moving-unmoving world stands in the heart-seed; who knows in truth: his, going-to-freedom.
premises: As banyan, so heart-seed world (the transfer).
His going-to-freedom (the dative fruit — initiation runs on).
ptv-p03-v25.question: What stands in the heart-seed?
ptv-p03-v25.speaker: Bhairava (transferring)
uncertainties: nirvāṇagāminī feminine — dīkṣā of v26 is the subject (enjambment kept).

ptv-p03-v26.inference: Initiation becomes undoubted, oblation-free — on crown, face, heart, hidden, form.
ptv-p03-v26.question: What initiation?
ptv-p03-v26.speaker: Bhairava (initiating)

ptv-p03-v27.inference: Placing done, topknot bound twenty-seven-muttered — every direction bound, all ten.
premises: Each direction bound, all ten (the closure).
ptv-p03-v27.question: What binding?
ptv-p03-v27.speaker: Bhairava (binding)

ptv-p04-v28.inference: Three claps with sound against obstacles; topknot-count water then sprinkled.
premises: Three claps with sound, before (the opening).
By topknot-count muttered, water sprinkled (the act).
ptv-p04-v28.question: What first in rite?
ptv-p04-v28.speaker: Bhairava (opening)

ptv-p04-v29.inference: Flowers, mark or altar; fourteen-muttered flower seat-making.
premises: Flower etc. in order, all (the offering).
ptv-p04-v29.question: What seat?
ptv-p04-v29.speaker: Bhairava (seating)

ptv-p04-v30.inference: There the hero worships emanation, then the seat; casketed, worship begins.
ptv-p04-v30.question: How worship?
ptv-p04-v30.speaker: Bhairava (ordering)

ptv-p04-v31.inference: Full of realities, all limbs graced — the great-fortuned worships the twenty-seven-enchanted goddess.
premises: Full of realities, all limbs graced (her praise).
ptv-p04-v31.question: Whom worship?
ptv-p04-v31.speaker: Bhairava (adoring)

ptv-p04-v32.inference: Fragrant flowers by power, supreme devotion — and self offered.
premises: Then fragrant flowers by power honored (the offering).
ptv-p04-v32.question: How honor?
ptv-p04-v32.speaker: Bhairava (offering)

ptv-p04-v33.inference: Worship told; even in fire this rule: remembering seed rightly, he succeeds.
premises: Even in fire-rite this rule (the extension).
Whose rule done, remembering seed: succeeds (the fruit).
ptv-p04-v33.question: What rule in fire?
ptv-p04-v33.speaker: Bhairava (ruling)

ptv-p04-v34.inference: Beginningless-endless blossoming seed mid-tithis in heart-lotus meditated; moon-ray ever practised.
ptv-p04-v34.question: What meditate?
ptv-p04-v34.speaker: Bhairava (sitting)

ptv-p04-v35.inference: Whatever desires wished quickly got; the unknowing goes to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.
premises: Which desires, them quickly got (the grant).
Unknowing to direct sight goes (the rise).
ptv-p04-v35.question: What may the unknowing get?
ptv-p04-v35.speaker: Bhairava (granting)

ptv-p04-v36.inference: Thus mantra-fruit getting: this Rudrayāmala; from practice, accomplishment and all-knowingness got.
premises: Thus mantra-fruit getting, this Rudra-pair-text (the naming).
ptv-p04-v36.question: What is got by practice?
ptv-p04-v36.speaker: Bhairava (sealing)

ptv-p01-v01.plain_english: O Lord, what is the Unsurpassable that grants Kaula fruit by itself — known by a mere touch of knowing, rising to kinship with the Sky-Goer?
ptv-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva svataḥ kaulikasiddhidam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ vrajet

ptv-p01-v02.plain_english: Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the Power that dwells in the heart, Kaulinī, mistress of the clan.
ptv-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: etad guhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulinī kulanāyikā

ptv-p01-v03.plain_english: Tell me of her, Lord of gods, by whom I come to fullness. — Listen, blessed Goddess: even the answer has one beyond it — the Unsurpassable.
ptv-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: tām me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ vrajāmy aham | śṛṇu devi mahābhage uttarasyāpy anuttaram

ptv-p01-v04.plain_english: I tell it, no doubt: swift Kaula-fruition. This Kaula rite, Goddess, abides in my heart-sky.
ptv-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: kathayāmi na saṃdehaḥ sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | kauliko 'yaṃ vidhir devi mama hṛdvyomny avasthitaḥ

ptv-p01-v05.plain_english: First now: all lunar days, vowels ending in the drop; within them, by time's conjoining, moon and sun are declared.
ptv-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: athādyās tithayaḥ sarve svarā bindvavasānakāḥ | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau

ptv-p01-v06.plain_english: Realities from earth to person, in five groups in order — in the ka-series and the rest, ending with the ma-sound, O fair-vowed one.
ptv-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: pṛthivyādīni tattvāni puruṣāntāni pañcasu | kramāt kādiṣu vargeṣu makārānteṣu suvrate

ptv-p01-v07.plain_english: Fourfold the stations of wind, fire, water and their lords; above them the famous śa-series, and before, the five Brahmas.
ptv-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: vāyvagnisalilendrāṇāṃ dhāraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam | tadūrdhve śādivikhyātam purastād brahmapañcakam

ptv-p01-v08.plain_english: Rootless, in due order, to be known, ending in kṣa — this forthgoing declared; of all mantras and wisdoms indeed, O glorious one.
ptv-p01-v08.sanskrit_cite: amūlā tatkramā jñeyā kṣāntā sṛṣṭir udāhṛtā | sarveṣāṃ caiva mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca yaśasvini

ptv-p01-v09.plain_english: This is the womb, ever told in all Tantras — joined with the fourteen and the tithi-lord's end; the third brahma, fair-hipped, the heart of Bhairava himself.
ptv-p01-v09.sanskrit_cite: iyaṃ yoniḥ samākhyātā sarvatantreṣu sarvadā | caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam | tṛtīyam brahma suśroṇi hṛdayam bhairavātmanaḥ

ptv-p02-v10.plain_english: Yoginī-born or Rudra — neither plainly wins this heart of the god of gods, swift giver of yoga's release.
ptv-p02-v10.sanskrit_cite: etan nā yoginījāto nā rudro labhate sphuṭam | hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam

ptv-p02-v11.plain_english: At its right utterance, the great host of mantra-seals comes face to face at once — marked by possession of one's own body.
ptv-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅ mantramudrāgaṇo mahān | sadyaḥ sanmukhatām eti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam

ptv-p02-v12.plain_english: Who remembers for a moment, in the kiss, navel-sealed — he binds body then, and the mantra-seal host, the man.
ptv-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: muhūrtaṃ smarate yas tu cumbake nābhimudritaḥ | sa badhnāti tadā dehaṃ mantramudrāgaṇaṃ naraḥ

ptv-p02-v13.plain_english: Asked, he tells past and future things — even within three hours, uttering the meant god-form.
ptv-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: atītānāgatānarthān pṛṣṭo 'sau kathayaty api | praharād yad abhipretaṃ devatārūpam uccaran

ptv-p02-v14.plain_english: Face to face he sees the undoubted, drawn by Rudra's powers; in two watches' time, sky-dwelling, remembering.
ptv-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: sakṣāt paśyaty asaṃdigdham ākṛṣṭaṃ rudrasaktibhiḥ | praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran

ptv-p02-v15.plain_english: By three: all mothers, mighty yoginīs, heroes, hero-lords, adepts, and the strong śākinī throng.
ptv-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogesvaryo mahābalāḥ | vīrā vīresvarāḥ siddhā balavān śākinīgaṇaḥ

ptv-p02-v16.plain_english: Come, pledged, urged by Bhairava — they grant supreme fruition, whatever fruit is wished.
ptv-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: āgatya samayaṃ dattvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ | yacchanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ phalaṃ yad vā samīhitam

ptv-p02-v17.plain_english: By this the perfected will perfect, and make mantra-men perfect.
ptv-p02-v17.sanskrit_cite: anena siddhāḥ setsyanti sādhayanti ca mantriṇaḥ

ptv-p02-v18.plain_english: Whatever in Bhairava's Tantra succeeds from this — by mantra-potency's possession-power, with no controller.
ptv-p02-v18.sanskrit_cite: yatkiṃcid bhairave tantre sarvam asmāt prasidhyati | mantravīryasamāveśaprabhāvān na niyantriṇā

ptv-p03-v19.plain_english: Who thus truly knows even the unseen circle shares fruition ever — yogin and initiate alike.
ptv-p03-v19.sanskrit_cite: adṛṣṭama.ṅdalo 'py evam yaḥ kaścid vetti tattvataḥ | sa siddhibhāg bhaven nityaṃ sa yogī sa ca dīkṣītaḥ

ptv-p03-v20.plain_english: By this mere known, all powers know; kinsman of the śākinī clan he may be, even without yoga.
ptv-p03-v20.sanskrit_cite: anena jñātamātreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ | śākinīkulasāmānyo bhaved yogaṃ vināpi hi

ptv-p03-v21.plain_english: Ignorant of rite yet knowing ordinance, he turns to worship — having made time-fire from the first, ending in māyā, gone to the brahma-body.
ptv-p03-v21.sanskrit_cite: avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati | kālāgnim āditaḥ kṛtvā māyāntam brahmadehagam

ptv-p03-v22.plain_english: Śiva, whose end is endless all, deemed the supreme power-triad; whatever stands on the pure path abides within that.
ptv-p03-v22.sanskrit_cite: śivo viśvadyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam | tadantar varti yatkiṃcic chuddhamārge vyavasthitam

ptv-p03-v23.plain_english: The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing; its mover is Śiva to be known, all-knowing highest Lord.
ptv-p03-v23.sanskrit_cite: aṇur viśuddham acirād aisvaraṃ jñānam aśnute | taccodakaḥ śivo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ

ptv-p03-v24.plain_english: All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — like the great power-formed tree standing in the banyan seed.
ptv-p03-v24.sanskrit_cite: sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchas tṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ | yathā nyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ

ptv-p03-v25.plain_english: So the moving-unmoving world stands in the heart-seed; who knows thus in truth — his is going-to-freedom.
ptv-p03-v25.sanskrit_cite: tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagad etac carācaram | evaṃ yo vetti tattvena tasya nirvāṇagāminī

ptv-p03-v26.plain_english: Initiation becomes undoubted, free of sesame-ghee offering — on crown, face, heart, secret, and image, so indeed.
ptv-p03-v26.sanskrit_cite: dīkṣā bhavaty asaṃdigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitā | mūrdhni vaktre ca hṛdaye guhye murtau tathaiva ca

ptv-p03-v27.plain_english: Placing done, topknot bound twenty-seven-muttered; with each one the ten quarters' binding he should have made.
ptv-p03-v27.sanskrit_cite: nyāsaṃ krtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃsatimantritām | ekaikena diśāṃ bandhaṃ daśānām api kārayet

ptv-p04-v28.plain_english: Three claps first, sounded, to clear obstacles; with thrice-muttered topknot-count water then sprinkled.
ptv-p04-v28.sanskrit_cite: tālatrayam purā dattvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye | śikhāsaṃkhyābhijaptena toyenābhyukṣayet tataḥ

ptv-p04-v29.plain_english: Flowers and all in order — liṅga or altar; with fourteen mutterings, a flower-seat made.
ptv-p04-v29.sanskrit_cite: puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅgaṃ vā stha.ṅdilaṃ ca vā | caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā

ptv-p04-v30.plain_english: There let the hero worship forthgoing, then the very seat again; casketed, let him begin the worship after.
ptv-p04-v30.sanskrit_cite: tatra sṛṣṭiṃ yajed vīraḥ punar evāsanaṃ tataḥ | sṛṣṭiṃ tu sampuṭīkṛtya paścād yajanam ārabhet

ptv-p04-v31.plain_english: Full of all realities, graced with every limb — let the fortunate worship the goddess, twenty-seven-muttered.
ptv-p04-v31.sanskrit_cite: sarvatattvasusampūrṇām sarvāvayavaśobhitām | yajed devīṃ mahābhāgā saptaviṃśatimantritām

ptv-p04-v32.plain_english: Then with fragrant flowers as able let him honor; with supreme devotion worship, and offer up himself.
ptv-p04-v32.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaiś ca yathāśaktyā samarcayet | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā svātmanaṃ ca nivedayet

ptv-p04-v33.plain_english: Thus the worship told — even in fire-rite this rule: who did the worship-rule, rightly remembering the seed, succeeds.
ptv-p04-v33.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yajanam ākhyātam agnikārye 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ | kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyak smaran bījam prasiddhyati

ptv-p04-v34.plain_english: Beginningless-endless seed, blossoming, gone mid-tithis — in the heart-lotus meditate the moon-ray, ever practise.
ptv-p04-v34.sanskrit_cite: ādyantarahitam bījaṃ vikasat tithimadhyagam | hṛtpadmāntargataṃ dhyāyet somāṃśuṃ nityam abhyasyet

ptv-p04-v35.plain_english: Which desires he desires, them quickly may he win; though unknowing, he goes to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.
ptv-p04-v35.sanskrit_cite: yān yān kāmayate kāmāṃs tān tāñ cchīghram avāpnuyāt | ajñaḥ pratyakṣatām eti sarvajñatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

ptv-p04-v36.plain_english: Thus mantra-fruit got — this Rudrayāmala; from this practice: fruition and all-knowingness are won.
ptv-p04-v36.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ mantraphalāvaptir ity etad rudrayāmalam | etad abhyāsataḥ siddhiḥ sarvajñatvam avāpyate

essence: Unsurpassable asked: Kaula fruit by autonomy, mere knowing to Khecarī-evenness.
Secret asked: heart-abiding Kaulinī clan-mistress.
Fullness asked; answer beyond answers promised.
No doubt, at once: Kaula rite in heart-sky told.
First: drop-ending vowels; moon-sun by time's yoking.
Earth-to-person realities in five, ka-to-ma classes.
Wind-fire-water supports fourfold; śa-famed brahma-five.
Rootless kṣa-ending emanation; of all mantras and wisdoms.
Ever-told womb; fourteen-joined; third brahma, Bhairava-self's heart.

rasa.justification: Wonder at recognition itself transformative — mere knowing to Khecarī-evenness — sharpened into seeking: Devī asks how, not what. The phonematic ground (vowels, classes, womb) amazes as power-map, not decoration.

sections.BOUNDARY: No powers are shown; the host gathers beyond the ground laid here.
sections.EXPLANATION: Fierce question (katham = by what means): the unsurpassable granting Kaula fruit by autonomy, recognition alone lifting to Khecarī-evenness. Secret asked: heart-abiding Kaulinī. Fullness asked; answer beyond answers promised. Promise: no doubt, at once, rite in heart-sky. Ground: drop-ending vowels with moon-sun time-yoked; earth-to-person realities in five ka-to-ma classes; fourfold supports; śa-famed brahma-five; rootless kṣa-ending emanation of all mantras and wisdoms; ever-told womb, fourteen-joined, third brahma — Bhairava-self's heart.
sections.FUNCTION: Asks the fierce question and lays the phonematic ground the answer will inhabit.
sections.KEY TERMS: anuttara (unsurpassable Subject — 16 Vivaraṇa readings); katham (how — means, not definition); kaulika-siddhi (in-this-body identity); vijñātamātra (mere recognition — the engine); khecarī (unobstructed power); tithi (moon-days as phonemes); yoni (womb-source — sauḥ decoding in lore, not gloss); svataḥ (by autonomy — source bytes, sadyaḥ recorded).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Question and ground: the how asked here is paid across powers, fruit, and rite.
sections.RELATED: Singh Vivaraṇa (sadyah/svataḥ fork, Laghuvṛtti autonomy); root anonymous, Abhinavagupta commentator; Rudrayāmala self-designation is the tantra's own claim (v36).
sections.SUMMARY: What grants Kaula fruit by itself, known by mere touch? The heart's Kaulinī, clan-mistress — tell her, for fullness. Even of the answer, one beyond: no doubt, at once, the rite in heart-sky. First vowels drop-ending, moon-sun time-yoked; earth-to-person in five ka-to-ma classes; supports fourfold, brahma-five śa-famed; rootless kṣa-ending emanation of all mantras and wisdoms; womb ever told, fourteen-joined, third brahma — Bhairava-self's heart.

essence: Heart withheld from yoginī-born and Rudra; swift yoga-release.
Right utterance: host face to face, body-possession-marked.
Moment remembered in kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host.
Asked tells past-future; within a watch, god-form uttered.
Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing.
By three: mothers, heroes, perfected, śākinī-host gather.
Come, pledged, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished.
By this the perfected perfect; mantra-men effected.
All in tantra succeeds; mantra-power, no controller.

rasa.justification: Wonder at exhibited efficacy — withheld heart, face-to-face host, past-future told, mothers gathering — braced by vīra: the powers are not admired but wielded (bound, effected, succeeded).

sections.BOUNDARY: No fruit is tasted; knowing begins beyond the powers.
sections.EXPLANATION: Exclusion (neither yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly gets the swift-releasing heart). Utterance rightly made: great host face to face, body-marked. Memory a moment in the kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host. Asked tells past-future; within a watch, meant god-form uttered. Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing, remembering. By three the mothers — heroes, perfected, śākinī-host — come, pledged, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished. By this the perfected perfect; mantra-men effected. All in Bhairava-tantra succeeds from this: mantra-potency power, no controller.
sections.FUNCTION: Demonstrates the heart's efficacy: exclusion, utterance, memory, vision, host, success.
sections.KEY TERMS: hṛdaya (heart of god of gods — withheld); sanmukhatā (face-to-faceness); cumbaka (kiss — Vivaraṇa collation open); prahara (watch — speed measured); śākinīgaṇa (host gathered); niyantṛ (controller — denied, mantra works itself).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Powers pledged in the opening question are exhibited here before fruit is tasted.
sections.RELATED: Khecarī-mudrā kiss hypothesis open; no-controller clause (efficacy without human manager).
sections.SUMMARY: Withheld from yoginī-born and Rudra alike, the heart gives swift release. Rightly uttered, the host stands face to face, body-marked. Remembered a moment in the kiss, navel-sealed: binds body and host. Asked, past and future told; within a watch, the god-form uttered. Undoubted seen, Rudra-drawn; two watches, sky-standing. By three the mothers gather — heroes, perfected, śākinī-host; come, pledged, urged: supreme fruit, whatever wished. By this the perfected perfect, mantra-men made; all in tantra succeeds by mantra-power, no controller.

essence: Unseen circle truly known: shares fruition, yogin, initiated.
Mere known by all powers; śākinī-common even without yoga.
Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing turns; time-fire to brahma-body.
Boundless Śiva, supreme triad; pure-path standers inside.
Atom reaches lordly knowing; impeller Śiva to be known.
All-going bright tree in banyan seed, power-formed.
Heart-seed world; knower's going-to-freedom.
Undoubted oblation-free initiation on five sites.
Placing done, topknot bound; all ten quarters bound.

rasa.justification: Knowing without apparatus, powers knowing without yoga, the atom arriving, the tree wholly in the seed, initiation without oblation — every verse stills means into being. The banyan/heart-seed holism (sarvam sarvātmakam) is quiescence imaged.

sections.BOUNDARY: No outer rite is given; the rite's body begins beyond the fruit.
sections.EXPLANATION: Unseen circle truly known: shares fruition ever — yogin and initiated (recognition without maṇḍala). By mere this known of all powers; śākinī-common even without yoga. Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing turns toward worship: time-fire from the first through māyā to brahma-body. Boundless-ended Śiva, supreme triad deemed; whatever stands on the pure path inside that. Atom soon reaches pure lordly knowing; its impeller Śiva to be known, all-knowing lord. All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — banyan-seed tree, power-formed. So the moving world in the heart-seed; the true knower's going-to-freedom (feminine runs to dīkṣā). Initiation undoubted, sesame-ghee-free, on crown, face, heart, hidden, form. Placing done, topknot twenty-seven-bound; each direction bound, all ten.
sections.FUNCTION: Tastes the fruit: knowing without apparatus, holism imaged, initiation internalized.
sections.KEY TERMS: adṛṣṭamaṇḍala (unseen circle — recognition without apparatus); vināpi yoga (even without yoga); sarvam sarvātmakam (holism — banyan/heart-seed); nirvāṇagāminī (going-to-freedom — feminine, dīkṣā runs on); nyāsa (placing — body mapped).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Fruit of the powers exhibited before; the feminine going-to-freedom runs into the initiation verse.
sections.RELATED: v19 radical (recognition without maṇḍala, per Yogawiki); enjambment v25→v26 kept; Vivaraṇa word-stages (vāk) behind the holism.
sections.SUMMARY: Even the unseen circle truly known shares fruition — yogin, initiated, ever. By mere this known of all powers, śākinī-common even without yoga. Rite-unknowing, ordinance-knowing turns: time-fire from the first through māyā to brahma-body. Boundless Śiva, supreme triad; the pure-pathed stand inside. The atom soon reaches lordly knowing; its mover Śiva to be known. All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — banyan-seed tree, power-formed. So the moving world in the heart-seed; the true knower's going-to-freedom. Initiation undoubted, oblation-free, on five sites; placing done, topknot bound: all ten quarters bound.

essence: Three claps sounded; topknot-count water sprinkled.
Flowers, mark or altar; fourteen-muttered seat.
Hero worships emanation, then seat; casketed, begin.
Realities-full, all-limbed goddess worshipped twenty-seven-muttered.
Fragrant flowers by power; devotion; self offered.
Worship told; fire-rite rule; seed remembered rightly succeeds.
Beginningless seed mid-tithis in heart-lotus; moon-ray practised.
Desires quickly got; unknowing to direct sight, no doubt.
Mantra-fruit got: Rudrayāmala; practice gives fruition.

rasa.justification: Injunctions accumulate — clap, sprinkle, seat, worship, casket, honor, meditate — yet every act closes (told, succeeded, got, no doubt). Vidhi gravity without agitation: rite performed is rite stilled.

sections.BOUNDARY: Nothing further is prescribed; practice is the last word.
sections.EXPLANATION: Rite's body: three claps with sound against obstacles; topknot-count water sprinkled. Flowers, mark or altar; fourteen-muttered seat-making. There the hero worships emanation, then the seat; casketed, worship begins. Realities-full, all-limbed, the fortunate worships the twenty-seven-muttered goddess. Fragrant flowers by power honored; supreme devotion worshipped; own self offered. Worship told; even in fire this rule: whose rule done, rightly remembering seed, succeeds. Beginningless-endless blossoming seed mid-tithis, gone inside heart-lotus, meditated; moon-ray ever practised. Whatever desires quickly got; the unknowing to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt. Thus mantra-fruit getting: this Rudrayāmala; from practice, accomplishment and all-knowingness got.
sections.FUNCTION: Gives the rite's body, then seals the tantra: told, practised, got.
sections.KEY TERMS: tālatraya (three claps); sampuṭīkṛtya (casketing — ritual enclosing); mahābhāgā (great-fortuned subject); svātmanivedana (self-offering — the inner oblation); bīja (seed); abhyāsa (practice — the last word); rudrayāmala (colophon name — own claim, not reconstructed corpus).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The rite's body answers the method-question of the opening; the colophon closes the how with got.
sections.RELATED: Sauḥ heart-mantra decoding lives in lore (received, not glossed); root anonymous, Abhinavagupta commentator; Rudrayāmala ascription caution (Yogawiki).
sections.SUMMARY: Three claps sounded against obstacles; topknot-count water sprinkled. Flowers, mark or altar; fourteen-muttered seat. The hero worships emanation, then the seat; casketed, begins. Realities-full, all-limbed, the fortunate worships the twenty-seven-muttered goddess. Fragrant flowers by power, supreme devotion — self offered. Worship told; even in fire this rule: seed rightly remembered succeeds. Beginningless seed mid-tithis, heart-lotus-meditated; moon-ray ever practised. Desires quickly got; the unknowing to direct sight — no doubt. Mantra-fruit got: this Rudrayāmala; from practice, fruition, all-knowingness.

lines: What is the Unsurpassable, Kaula-fruiting of itself,
that by mere knowing brings Khecarī-evenness?
ptv-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva svataḥ kaulikasiddhidam | yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ vrajet

lines: Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the heart-dwelling Power,
Kaulinī, mistress of the clan.
ptv-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: etad guhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulinī kulanāyikā

lines: Tell me of her, god of gods, by whom I come to fullness. —
Hear, blessed Lady: beyond all answering, the Unsurpassed.
ptv-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: tām me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ vrajāmy aham | śṛṇu devi mahābhage uttarasyāpy anuttaram

lines: I tell it, doubt it not: swift Kaula-fruit it gives —
this Kaula rite, O Goddess, in my heart-sky lives.
ptv-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: kathayāmi na saṃdehaḥ sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | kauliko 'yaṃ vidhir devi mama hṛdvyomny avasthitaḥ

lines: First now: all lunar days, vowels ending in the bindu-dot;
within them, time-yoked, moon and sun are named.
ptv-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: athādyās tithayaḥ sarve svarā bindvavasānakāḥ | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau

lines: From earth to person, tattvas five by five in train —
in ka-classes, ma-ending, in order they remain.
ptv-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: pṛthivyādīni tattvāni puruṣāntāni pañcasu | kramāt kādiṣu vargeṣu makārānteṣu suvrate

of the ten, let bonds be made.

with topknot-count thrice-told, then sprinkle water.

though unknowing, direct sight he'll attain — all-knowing, no doubt's stain.
